data.message: Retrieving the official financial statement PDF from the CSE document repository
Document secured and staged for processing
Running multi-dimensional financial health diagnostics with LLM (this may take a minute)...
Health diagnostics finalised for SOY.N0000 — overall score: 74/100 · Good

standardHealthChecks.name: Liquidity Health
standardHealthChecks.description: The company maintains an exceptionally liquid balance sheet with a Current Ratio of 4.18x and a Quick Ratio of 3.37x. Cash and short-term deposits total Rs. 2.55 billion against current liabilities of Rs. 1.12 billion, providing a huge liquidity buffer.

standardHealthChecks.name: Profitability Health
standardHealthChecks.description: Revenue grew by 12.1% YoY to Rs. 1.69 billion. However, gross profit fell by 9.1% due to a 24.1% rise in cost of sales, causing the gross margin to drop from 36.3% to 29.5%. Net profit for the period fell 18.4% YoY to Rs. 142.85 million, yielding an annualized ROE of ~13.8%.

standardHealthChecks.name: Debt Management
standardHealthChecks.description: The company operates almost entirely free of long-term bank debt. Total liabilities represent only 32.8% of equity, mostly consisting of trade payables, tax obligations, and lease liabilities. Interest coverage is virtually unlimited (~59x including lease finance charges).

standardHealthChecks.name: Cash Flow Health
standardHealthChecks.description: Operating cash flow was negative at Rs. (60.15) million for the quarter, primarily driven by working capital lock-up in trade receivables (+Rs. 189M) and inventory (+Rs. 83.8M). However, strong investment income (Rs. 60M) and large cash reserves minimize cash distress.

dynamicHealthChecks.name: Cost Structure & Input Inflation Management
dynamicHealthChecks.description: Cost of sales surged by 24.1% YoY, significantly outstripping top-line revenue growth of 12.1%. This reflects cost pressure on raw materials/packaging, eroding the gross margin by 6.8 percentage points.
dynamicHealthChecks.relevanceReason: In FMCG food manufacturing, input cost fluctuations (soybeans, packaging, energy) directly dictate gross margin stability and operational survival.

dynamicHealthChecks.name: Working Capital Efficiency
dynamicHealthChecks.description: Trade receivables expanded 20% in three months from Rs. 941M to Rs. 1.13B, and inventories rose 10.2% to Rs. 908.7M, absorbing cash flow despite steady sales growth.
dynamicHealthChecks.relevanceReason: Fast-moving consumer goods manufacturers require tight credit collection cycles and optimal inventory turnover to avoid tied-up cash and spoilage risks.

dynamicHealthChecks.name: Operating Cost Discipline & R&D
dynamicHealthChecks.description: Selling expenses decreased by 22.8% YoY to Rs. 61.2M, demonstrating marketing cost optimization. R&D spending increased by 6.2% to Rs. 8.1M, supporting product innovation (e.g., Lankasoy, Sera, Nutriline, Tetos).
dynamicHealthChecks.relevanceReason: Continuous product development and prudent control of distribution/selling costs are critical to defending market share in competitive food categories.

recommendations: Implement price adjustments or supply chain cost-saving initiatives to mitigate the 24.1% increase in cost of sales and restore gross margins toward historical levels (~35%+).
Tighten credit terms and collection efforts to reverse the 20% growth in trade receivables and improve operating cash flow.
Optimize raw material and finished goods holding levels to reduce inventory lock-up and prevent cash drain.
Deploy surplus cash reserves (Rs. 2.55 billion in deposits and cash) into yield-enhancing investments or strategic capacity expansions.
result.analysisNotes: Convenience Foods (Lanka) PLC demonstrates an exceptionally strong balance sheet characterized by near-zero debt and massive liquid cash reserves. Main areas requiring operational focus are cost of sales management and working capital optimization.
